name: Jagat Seth
contribution: The Jagat Seth banking house financed the Murshidabad court and became associated with the political coalition that opposed Siraj ud-Daulah around Plassey.
context: In eighteenth-century Bengal, banking, revenue flows, and court politics were closely connected. The house’s position shows how commercial finance entered negotiations over sovereignty in 1757.
impact: Jagat Seth’s role helps explain the financial and elite alliances surrounding Plassey and the transfer of political influence toward the East India Company.
highlight: The Murshidabad banking house whose court finance became part of the politics surrounding Plassey.
seoTitle: Jagat Seth: Banking Power and the Politics of Plassey
seoDescription: Learn about the Jagat Seth banking house, its role in Murshidabad court finance, and its place in the political alliances surrounding the Battle of Plassey.
shortAnswer: Jagat Seth was a powerful banking house in Murshidabad whose finance and political connections mattered in the events surrounding Plassey.
